title: Reading Drill — Studying compost bins in courtyards — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Studying compost bins in courtyards — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The housing project lead had been asked to investigate residents avoiding bins with awkward lids in Millcross. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on use per week, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a four-week comparison, the team used collection logs at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because holiday occupancy might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward lighter lids with handles. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
